Package index

IVX estimation

Predictive regressions with persistent regressors, short and long horizon (Kostakis, Magdalinos & Stamatogiannis 2015, 2023).

ivx() print(<ivx>)
Fitting IVX Models
ivx_sys() print(<ivx_sys>) summary(<ivx_sys>)
Fitting Systems of IVX Predictive Regressions

Extensions

Modifications of the IVX estimator for specific error structures or targets.

ivx_ar() print(<ivx_ar>)
Fitting IVX-AR Models
ivx_ra() print(<ivx_ra>)
Fitting Residual-Augmented IVX Models
ivx_qr() print(<ivx_qr>) summary(<ivx_qr>)
Fitting IVX Quantile Predictive Regressions

Robust and subsample inference

Wild bootstrap p-values and tests for pockets of predictability (Demetrescu et al. 2022, 2023).

ivx_boot() print(<ivx_boot>)
Wild Bootstrap Inference for IVX Models
ivx_qr_boot() print(<ivx_qr_boot>)
Moving Block Bootstrap for IVX-QR
ivx_episodic() print(<ivx_episodic>)
Subsample IVX Tests for Episodic Predictability
